posts.title: A Flurry of Library Updates: Frank 7.3.3

posts.title: Early Results from AI Agents + Hypermedia Experiments
posts.description: In my last post, I wrote that hypermedia might be sufficient for both humans and AI agents. By hypermedia I mean affordances, accessibility, discoverability, linked data, and other features built into web browsers to support more robust and correct human and machine interactions. posts.title: This is for Everyone, Even AI Agents
posts.description: In this post I reflect on Tim Berners-Lee's memoir, emphasizing his optimistic view of LLMs and their potential to enhance human access to information. I explore how a hypermedia application can be tested with agents and highlight the significance of features like accessibility and discovery.
